summary: The sole analysed occurrence is already the entry's example. Feminine mdamšo agrees with iḏe, the hand bearing the sticky state; admo supplies the substance without an expressed preposition.
The German presents blood sticking to the hand, while Turoyo makes the hand the state bearer. Preserve the source argument structure rather than promote admo to subject from the translation.
The result-state interpretation does not independently establish a Part. Pass. box or an agent-caused Detransitive reading. Retain the inherited Detransitive Preterit.
No new sense, example, idiom or correction is supported by this single already-quoted context.
Is unmarked admo an ordinary substance complement of this sticky-state predicate, or does the construction have a narrower lexical restriction? One attestation cannot decide.
